dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 31, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**YANKEES SHUT DOWN CUBS IN DOMINANT 2-0 WIN**

The New York Yankees continued their strong start to the season, blanking the Chicago Cubs 2-0 behind a stellar performance from Will Warren. Warren tossed 6.2 scoreless innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 4 hits. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a solo home run, his 4th of the season. The Cubs' Shota Imanaga was tagged with the loss after allowing 2 runs over 6 innings.

**REDs RALLY PAST PIRATES IN THRILLING 8-7 WIN**

The Cincinnati Reds overcame a 7-8 deficit to take down the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7. Sal Stewart hit a go-ahead home run, his 4th of the season, to give the Reds the lead. Nathaniel Lowe's fielder's choice RBI in the top of the 8th proved to be the difference-maker. Antwone Kelly pitched 3 strong innings out of the bullpen for the Reds, striking out 3 and allowing just 2 hits.

**ORIOLES TAKE DOWN PHILLIES IN 6-4 WIN**

The Baltimore Orioles edged the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4 behind a strong start from Andrew Painter. Painter pitched 6 innings, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs. Pete Alonso hit a solo home run for the Phillies, his 4th of the season. Gunnar Henderson tripled and scored a run for the Orioles, who took advantage of a crucial error by Phillies second baseman Brandon Lowe.
